crossRefs.note: “You shall make the altar of acacia wood, five cubits long, and five cubits wide. The altar shall be square. Its height…
Then he made an altar of bronze, twenty cubits long, twenty cubits wide, and ten cubits high.
In spite of their fear because of the peoples of the surrounding lands, they set the altar on its base; and they…
He made the altar of burnt offering of acacia wood. It was square. Its length was five cubits, its width was five…
He made its horns on its four corners. Its horns were of one piece with it, and he overlaid it with bronze.

translations.web: The altar hearth shall be twelve cubits long by twelve wide, square in its four sides.
translations.bsb: The altar hearth shall be square at its four corners, twelve cubits long and twelve cubits wide.
translations.kjv: And the altar shall be twelve cubits long, twelve broad, square in the four squares
translations.asv: And the altar hearth shall be twelve cubits long by twelve broad, square in the four sides thereof.
